import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)

# Display the first few rows and the columns of the dataframe
df.head(), df.columns

# Check for missing values in 'cat_type' and 'yield_pct' columns
missing_values = df[['cat_type', 'yield_pct']].isnull().sum()
missing_values

# Drop rows with missing 'cat_type' values
df_cleaned = df.dropna(subset=['cat_type'])

# Compute the mean yield percentage grouped by 'cat_type'
mean_yield_by_cat_type = df_cleaned.groupby('cat_type')['yield_pct'].mean().reset_index()

mean_yield_by_cat_type
